## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sobhitabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 8) is a biographical poem situated in the *Buddhavaṁsa* of the Pali Khuddakanikāya, chronicling the life, awakening, and dispensation of the past Buddha Sobhita. Within the structural schema of the *Buddhavaṁsa*, each chapter normally presents the biography of a past Buddha alongside an embedded history of the Bodhisatta (the future Gotama Buddha) during that era, detailing his status and his *adhitthāna* ("determination") to fulfill the ten perfections (*pāramīs*) [Gaffney 2003]. Unusually, this formal resolution to fulfill the *pāramīs* is omitted in the *Sobhitabuddhavaṁsa* (a feature shared only with the *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa*), whereas the remaining Buddha chronicles include this programmatic dedication [Gaffney 2003].
